question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 4% per month for 11 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Rate % = Rate per month × Time in months

Effective Rate % = 4% × 11 = 44%

Simple Interest = 44% of Principal

SI = (44 ÷ 100) × 1200 = 528

**∴ The correct answer is ₹528.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,200

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per month

Time (T) = 11 months

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Start
 ₹1,200
 
 11 Months
 + ₹528
 
 
 

 
 
 
 Interest = 4% × 11 = 44%
 Total SI = 44% of ₹1,200 = ₹528

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

*(Note: Since the rate is given per month and time is in months, no unit conversion is required.)*

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (1200 × 4 × 11) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × 44

⇒ SI = 528

**∴ The correct answer is ₹528.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Matching in Simple Interest

Ensure the time period matches the interest rate period. If the rate is per month, the time must be calculated in months. If the rate is per annum (yearly), time given in months must be converted to years (Months ÷ 12).

Amount Formula

The total amount (A) after a given time is the sum of the Principal (P) and Simple Interest (SI). The mathematical formula is: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT ÷ 100).

Simple vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated strictly on the initial principal only. In contrast, Compound Interest is calculated on the initial principal as well as the accumulated interest from the previous periods.
